senses.en: The mother cooks sweet potatoes for her children.

records.text: ina kalu bulayan mutalek alaw saapakan rakihan

senses.zh: 母親用鍋子煮魚來餵小孩
senses.en: Mother uses a pan to cook fish to feed a child.

records.text: patalek rumut naki a maxiasu ki taupungu

senses.en: The boss asked my daughter-in-law to cook meat.

records.text: pinatalekan naki a maxiasu ki rumut ni taupungu

senses.en: The boss made my daughter-in-law cook meat.

records.text: taleken a barabu ka riak a kakanen

senses.en: The cooked snails are delicious to eat.

citation.label: 《巴宰語詞典》p.288，talek- 條下派生詞

senses.en: the pot that can be used to cook fish
The pan is used to cook fish.

records.text: pinarisan talima rakihan meken riak, makuris iteken

senses.zh: 自己生的孩子吃的好，卻又瘦又矮
senses.en: (Kalayu's) own child ate good food, yet he was thin and short.

records.text: aba, mausay di muzakay talima daran

senses.zh: 爸爸，我要去走自己的路
senses.en: Daddy, I would like to lead my own life.

senses.zh: 自己生的孩子給他吃稀飯
senses.en: She fed her own child with rice gruel.
